name: ci-watch
description: Watches the CI of your pull requests and starts a turn when a PR turns red, conflicts or is green to merge, so no agent sleep-polls CI. The option fix_turns=off keeps the notifications and starts no turn for red CI and conflicts. Other mods and the model add a PR through the tool mcp__ci-watch__watch.

fix_turns.title: Fix turns
fix_turns.description: on: a red or conflicted PR starts a turn that fixes it. off: it only gets a toast and a notification; use off when another watcher (the desktop app Auto-fix) does the fix. The green path is the same for the two values.
